cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.17)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(MSVC)
add_compile_options("$<$<C_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/utf-8>")
add_compile_options("$<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/utf-8>")
SET( CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} /level='requireAdministrator' /uiAccess='false' /SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS /ENTRY:mainCRTStartup" )
endif()

# ── WGL_NV_DX_interop + Qt OpenGL 编译选项 ──
# 启用后 muxPlayer 库将包含 GLInterop + GLPlayWidget 类
# 要求：Qt5 (Core/Gui/Widgets/OpenGL)、OpenGL
option(ENABLE_WGL_INTEROP "Enable WGL_NV_DX_interop OpenGL rendering support" ON)

# ── HTTP-FLV 拉流功能开关 ──
option(MUXPLAY_ENABLE_FLV "Enable HTTP-FLV streaming support" ON)

find_package(FFMPEG REQUIRED)
find_package(mttool CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(fdk-aac CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(log-cpp CONFIG REQUIRED)
if(MUXPLAY_ENABLE_FLV)
    find_package(cpr CONFIG REQUIRED)
    find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED)
endif()

file(GLOB_RECURSE CPPSRC_DIR_LIST "*.cpp" )
file(GLOB_RECURSE HEADERSRC_DIR_LIST "*.h" )

# ── 根据 ENABLE_WGL_INTEROP 过滤源码 ──
if(NOT ENABLE_WGL_INTEROP)
    list(FILTER CPPSRC_DIR_LIST EXCLUDE REGEX "gl_interop|gl_play")
    list(FILTER HEADERSRC_DIR_LIST EXCLUDE REGEX "gl_interop|gl_play")
endif()

# FLV 关闭时排除 flv_demuxing 文件
if(NOT MUXPLAY_ENABLE_FLV)
    list(FILTER CPPSRC_DIR_LIST EXCLUDE REGEX "flv_demuxing")
    list(FILTER HEADERSRC_DIR_LIST EXCLUDE REGEX "flv_demuxing")
endif()

set(AllFile ${HEADERSRC_DIR_LIST} ${CPPSRC_DIR_LIST})
foreach(fileItem ${AllFile})
    # Get the directory of the source file
    get_filename_component(PARENT_DIR "${fileItem}" DIRECTORY)
    # Remove common directory prefix to make the group
    string(REPLACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "" GROUP "${PARENT_DIR}")
    # Make sure we are using windows slashes
    string(REPLACE "/" "\\" GROUP "${GROUP}")
    # Group into "Source Files" and "Header Files"
    set(GROUP "${GROUP}")
    source_group("${GROUP}" FILES "${fileItem}")
endforeach()

# 添加库
if(MUXPLAY_BUILD_SHARED)
add_library(muxPlayer SHARED 
    ${HEADERSRC_DIR_LIST}
    ${CPPSRC_DIR_LIST})
else()
add_library(muxPlayer 
    STATIC
    ${HEADERSRC_DIR_LIST}
    ${CPPSRC_DIR_LIST})
endif()

# 设置导出宏
target_compile_definitions(muxPlayer
    PRIVATE
        DX_PLAYER_LIBRARY
    PUBLIC
        $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:>
        $<$<BOOL:${MUXPLAY_ENABLE_FLV}>:MUXPLAY_ENABLE_FLV>
)

# ── WGL interop：Qt 依赖 + OpenGL + MOC 支持 ──
if(ENABLE_WGL_INTEROP)
    # Qt 路径（由顶层 -DQT5_PATH=... 传入）
    if(QT5_PATH)
        set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH ${QT5_PATH})
    endif()
    find_package(Qt5 COMPONENTS Core Gui Widgets OpenGL REQUIRED)
    find_package(OpenGL REQUIRED)

    set_target_properties(muxPlayer PROPERTIES
        AUTOMOC ON
    )

    target_compile_definitions(muxPlayer
        PUBLIC
            ENABLE_WGL_INTEROP
    )

    target_link_libraries(muxPlayer
        PUBLIC
            Qt5::Core
            Qt5::Gui
            Qt5::Widgets
            Qt5::OpenGL
            OpenGL::GL
            log-cpp::log-cpp
    )

endif()

# 包含头文件目录
target_include_directories(muxPlayer
    PUBLIC
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
        $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
    PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        ${FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

# 链接库
target_link_libraries(muxPlayer
    PUBLIC
    mttool::mttool
    ${FFMPEG_LIBRARIES}
    mtAudio
    FDK-AAC::fdk-aac
    d3dcompiler
    tmcore      # GPU 枚举 / D3D11 设备创建
)

# FLV 依赖（仅在开启时链接）
if(MUXPLAY_ENABLE_FLV)
    target_link_libraries(muxPlayer
        PUBLIC
            cpr::cpr
            OpenSSL::SSL
            OpenSSL::Crypto
            flvParser
    )
endif()

# 设置 Windows 导出符号
if(WIN32)
    set_target_properties(muxPlayer PROPERTIES
        WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON
        DEFINE_SYMBOL IPC_SERVICE_LIBRARY
    )
endif()

# 设置版本信息
set_target_properties(muxPlayer PROPERTIES
    VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
    SOVERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR}
    OUTPUT_NAME "muxPlayer"
)
